data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit umā, 'splendour, light'; also a name of Parvati. Its root is Sanskrit umā (उमा). Uma, a name of the goddess Parvati. Uma is a Sanskrit name meaning “Splendour; light; (also) flax”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Uma expresses “Splendour; light; (also) flax”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit umā, 'splendour, light'; also a name of Parvati.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uma total 8, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
